title: Preserve selections when batch closing issues fails
steps: Inspect the issues list with Publish release and Prepare release notes selected, and Complete release review unselected.
Click Close in the batch toolbar and inspect the resulting issues list.

video_guide.summary: Attempt to close the two selected release issues and inspect the resulting list and selection state.

chapters.label: Inspect the selected release issues in the issues list.

chapters.note: Publish release and Prepare release notes are checked; Complete release review is unchecked.

chapters.label: Click Close in the batch toolbar.

chapters.note: The two release issues are unchecked, and the filter toolbar replaces the batch actions.
The list shows 3 Open and 0 Closed; no failure message is visible in this frame.
